name: Cronitor
verdict_reason: Healthchecks is excellent and installs in half an hour. Cronitor's solo tier is $2/mo. If your time is worth anything at all, the subscription wins — and the monitor watching your cron jobs shouldn't share fate with the box running them.
what_you_lose: Independence: self-hosted on the same infra it watches, an outage takes out the alarm too

what_broke: The image's built-in healthcheck probes the database connection, and the sqlite default has no writable path in the stock container — it 500s forever until you either mount the sqlite dir correctly or (better) give it the Postgres it actually wants

Compose re-verified 2026-08-31: boot to healthy in 19s (healthchecks:latest + postgres:16-alpine, fresh pull). healthchecks last commit 2026-08-28, v4.3 released 2026-07-14; project active. Verdict NOT_REALLY holds: net saving is -$1.83/mo at $20/hr reference rate — economics never clear.
